packs.treatment: Twenty-two private editable sources. Four author rigs retain original clips/bone names, mirrored for right-handed use. Pose version 6 replaces only the eighteen lowered actions per survivor: idle shoulder/elbow/wrist mirror the free arm, locomotion uses a restrained counter-phase shoulder swing and relaxed forearm, and coherent palm tilt keeps muzzles down. Aim, fire and reload action curves, geometry and rest bones remain identical to the previous checkpoint. All 54 firearm actions remain on each rig; raised poses keep selected-arm/finger baking, independent support targets and receiver reload gestures. Author leg curves remain untouched; runtime uses a separate locomotion layer so reload/fire do not freeze walking. Six firearms and same-rig author melee clips; no cross-rig retargeting. Three unarmored vehicle types spawn; collected parts select matching armored derivatives. Preserved road tiles are no longer rendered; one custom asphalt mesh supplies matching collision. Source/GLB hashes remain verified.

original_assets.editable_sources: The original 21 sources and nine neighborhood house/interior sources remain preserved. Private district/ adds six dimensioned editable buildings and sixteen furnishings/supply props. A shared authored plan defines doors, window openings, floors, upstairs stair openings, partitions and model collision; cottages, townhouses, farmhouses, gas/auto shop, grocery and convenience store use distinct layouts. The original home footprint preserves base coordinates and adds a street entrance/roof underside. Safe/fridge pivots remain attached to their editable hinges.
original_assets.export: Blender background explicit Y-up GLB, action export, mesh joining for runtime surfaces; swinging DoorPivot stays separate. Outputs regenerated to external generated/ folder. Generator refuses existing editable sources unless --replace-existing is explicit; --only zombie permits a focused checkpoint repair. Existing private sources are reproducibly exported without saving changes by scripts/export_assets.py; every source hash is checked.
original_assets.audio: Quiet original 24-second filtered-noise wind, seed 4815. Previous original synthetic effects remain reproducible from the first checkpoint but recorded CC0 effects replace them in runtime. An original deterministic eight-second combustion-engine loop (22050Hz mono, seed1045) varies pitch/gain in game. Harmonic phase is periodic and the noise component wraps to avoid a seam click; JSON parameters/hash and WAV are private.
original_assets.limitations: Low-poly prototype; firearms use baked same-rig actions and broad hand contact rather than runtime individual-finger IK or detachable magazines. Armor is cosmetic; vehicles have no seated animation/fuel/damage. Raft, backpack and campfire mechanics remain decorative. ITHappy complex shader mixing remains simplified. Nearby growls use licensed CC0 recordings documented above.
original_assets.district_generator: scripts/create_district.py; private building-plans.json must agree with game/building_plans.json. Export-only reads sources without saving; --update-buildings deliberately regenerates only buildings and retains Blender backups.
